title: Managerial and Financial Barriers to the Green Transition
authors: Ralph De Haas; Ralf Martin; Mirabelle Muûls; Helena Schweiger
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. Tables 1-2 are firm-level cross-sectional OLS/IV (credit constraints and green management instrumented with local banking-structure variables, region and sector FE). Table 3 is a facility-level cross-section on predicted constraints. Table 4 is a facility DiD with a continuous exposure (wf1p07d15, local banks' 2007 reliance on wholesale funding) interacted with a common post-2007 indicator (after07) or 2008-13/2014-17 period dummies, plus controls: continuous treatment, single date.
design_notes: 1_dmms_replication.do. Table 4: collapse to facility x (pre/post 2007) then xtreg y c.wf1p07d15##after07 npbd15 lmassetp07d15, fe vce(cluster facid); event version with yr_plus1-10 x wf1p07d15 (appendix). E-PRTR facility emissions panel 2004/2007-2017.
estimators_reported: continuous-exposure DiD with facility FE (common 2007 date)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Single shock date (2007-08 global financial crisis); exposure is continuous.
excluded_specs_summary: Tables 1-3: cross-section OLS/IV. Table 4 cols 1-8: continuous wholesale-funding exposure x post-2007 (or period dummies) with facility FE and time-varying controls.
data_provenance_note: Final analysis files shipped; firm GPS coordinates replaced by random mock coordinates (used only for Figure 1); instruments built from true coordinates are included.
screener_notes: Cross-sectional IV paper; the only panel design is a continuous-exposure single-date DiD.
